name: Salesforce
description: Enterprise cloud CRM and customer 360 data platform.
api_surface: Extensive REST, SOAP, GraphQL, Bulk 2.0, Streaming APIs & Apex endpoints.
main_blocker: None. Free Developer Org allows full sandbox testing; complex object schema discovery required.
composio_strategy: Expose standard objects (Lead, Contact, Opportunity) + dynamic SOQL query tool via OAuth2.

name: HubSpot
description: Inbound marketing, sales CRM, and customer service platform.
api_surface: Modern REST API v3 across CRM objects, marketing, deals, webhooks.
main_blocker: None. Instant free developer test accounts with Private App token access.
composio_strategy: Maintain first-class Private App Token & OAuth2 connectors with dynamic property mapping.

name: Pipedrive
description: Pipeline-centric sales CRM and deal management system.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API v1 covering Deals, Persons, Leads, Pipelines, Webhooks.
main_blocker: None. Free 14-day trial & developer sandbox app creation available.
composio_strategy: Wrap deal stage progression, lead creation, and activity logging into agent action primitives.

name: Attio
description: Real-time, flexible next-generation relationship CRM.
api_surface: Modern REST API v2 with granular scopes, webhooks, and dynamic schema objects.
main_blocker: None. Free tier includes API key generation with full object CRUD.
composio_strategy: Leverage dynamic schema endpoints (`/v2/objects`) for self-adapting agent tool schemas.

name: Twenty
description: Modern open-source CRM alternative to Salesforce.
api_surface: REST & GraphQL APIs generated from Postgres data models; OpenAPI 3.0 spec.
main_blocker: None. Open source self-hostable docker image or free cloud sandbox.
composio_strategy: Provide dual connection mode: Twenty Cloud (API Key/OAuth) or Self-Hosted instance URL.

name: Podio
description: Citrix workspace and customizable project/CRM tracking platform.
api_surface: Full REST API covering workspaces, items, fields, webhooks, files.
main_blocker: Legacy rate limits (250 req/hour for standard apps) and nested item ID resolution.
composio_strategy: Build rate-limit queuing and app space resolver into Composio tool wrapper.

name: Zoho CRM
description: Omnichannel CRM suite for enterprise sales management.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API v2/v3/v6 across Leads, Contacts, Deals, Modules.
main_blocker: Multi-datacenter domain routing (`.com`, `.eu`, `.in`, `.com.au`, `.com.cn`) required in OAuth handshake.
composio_strategy: Composio handles automatic DC domain detection during OAuth authorization callback.

name: Close
description: Inside sales CRM featuring built-in calling, SMS, and email sequences.
api_surface: Complete REST API (Leads, Contacts, Activities, Calls, Opportunities), Webhooks.
main_blocker: Paid subscription required after 14-day trial for ongoing developer testing.
composio_strategy: Use HTTP Basic with API Key as username; map call logging and lead pipeline updates.

name: Copper
description: Google Workspace-integrated CRM for relationship management.
api_surface: REST API v1 across Leads, People, Companies, Opportunities, Projects.
main_blocker: Requires a Google Workspace account to sign up for trial and generate API tokens.
composio_strategy: Create dual-header auth wrapper (`X-PW-AccessToken` + `X-PW-UserEmail`).

name: DealCloud
description: Specialized investment banking and private capital CRM platform.
api_surface: REST API v1/v2 for Entries, Lists, Fields, Schema metadata via enterprise gateway.
main_blocker: Closed enterprise wall. API credentials require sales contract and IP whitelisting.
composio_strategy: Target as bespoke Enterprise Custom Toolkit; provide BYO-Credentials client credentials flow.

name: Zendesk
description: Enterprise customer service ticketing and knowledge base platform.
api_surface: Extensive Support, Chat, Talk, and Guide REST APIs with Sunshine Events.
main_blocker: None. Free sponsored Developer Accounts available for integration testing.
composio_strategy: Support ticket triage, macro execution, and comment appending tools via OAuth/Token.

name: Intercom
description: AI-powered customer service, live messenger, and helpdesk platform.
api_surface: Modern REST API v2.11+ (Conversations, Contacts, Articles, Admins, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Free Developer Hub allows instant sandbox test workspace creation.
composio_strategy: Implement conversation reply, contact tagging, and help center search actions.

name: Freshdesk
description: Cloud-based customer support software and ticketing solution.
api_surface: REST API v2 covering Tickets, Contacts, Companies, Solutions, Webhooks.
main_blocker: None. Free plan (up to 10 agents) provides complete API access.
composio_strategy: Wrap ticket creation, agent assignment, and SLA tracking tools.

name: Front
description: Customer communication hub and shared collaborative inbox.
api_surface: Core REST API (Conversations, Messages, Inboxes, Rules, Channels), Webhooks.
main_blocker: Trial or paid plan required for active webhook endpoint subscription.
composio_strategy: Enable shared inbox message draft creation and routing automation.

name: Pylon
description: Support platform syncing Slack, Teams, email, and ticketing for B2B.
api_surface: Modern REST API (Issues, Messages, Broadcasts, Accounts, Contacts).
main_blocker: Rapidly evolving API schema; requires active workspace onboarding.
composio_strategy: Build B2B issue triage and channel-syncing action primitives.

name: LiveAgent
description: Live chat and help desk ticketing software for small to mid-sized businesses.
api_surface: REST API v3 with full Swagger / OpenAPI definition.
main_blocker: None. Free tier and 14-day trial include full API keys.
composio_strategy: Auto-generate toolkit actions directly from LiveAgent OpenAPI spec.

name: Plain
description: Developer-first customer service platform and support API.
api_surface: Modern GraphQL API & REST endpoints (Threads, Customers, Events, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Generous free tier with immediate API token generation.
composio_strategy: Wrap GraphQL mutations into atomic agent tool actions (reply, snooze, add label).

name: Help Scout
description: Shared inbox and customer management tool for growing companies.
api_surface: Mailbox API v2 (Conversations, Customers, Mailboxes, Ratings, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Free 15-day trial allows full OAuth2 app registration.
composio_strategy: Support OAuth2 Client Credentials and Authorization Code flows.

name: Gorgias
description: E-commerce customer service and helpdesk built for Shopify merchants.
api_surface: REST API (Tickets, Customers, Messages, Macros, E-commerce integrations).
main_blocker: Best tested with a connected Shopify/WooCommerce development store.
composio_strategy: Integrate ticket response and Shopify order lookups within Gorgias toolkit.

name: Gladly
description: Customer-centric service platform consolidating all conversation channels.
api_surface: REST API (Events, Customers, Conversations, Tasks, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Enterprise gated. API tokens can only be generated inside provisioned enterprise instances.
composio_strategy: Support as BYO-Instance enterprise integration; document setup for enterprise customers.

name: Slack
description: Enterprise messaging and channel-based collaboration platform.
api_surface: Massive Web API (REST), Events API, Socket Mode, Block Kit UI builder.
main_blocker: None. Free instant app creation with granular scope selection at `api.slack.com`.
composio_strategy: Provide full conversational abilities: channel post, thread reply, modal popups, reaction tools.

name: Twilio
description: Programmable communication APIs for SMS, Voice, Video, and Verification.
auth_types: HTTP Basic Auth (Account SID + Auth Token)
api_surface: Complete REST API across Programmable Messaging, Voice, Verify, Lookup, Webhooks.
main_blocker: Regulatory compliance (A2P 10DLC registration required for US carrier delivery).
composio_strategy: Wrap SMS send, call trigger, OTP verification, and lookup into discrete agent tools.

name: Zoho Cliq
description: Business communication and internal team collaboration tool.
api_surface: REST API v2 (Channels, Messages, Bots, Schedulers, Forms).
main_blocker: Regional domain partitioning across international data centers.
composio_strategy: Incorporate multi-region datacenter resolution for global Zoho customers.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
description: Enterprise collaboration super-app (IM, Docs, Video, Calendar).
api_surface: Extensive Open Platform REST API, Event Subscriptions, CardKit messages.
main_blocker: Permission scope approval workflow within enterprise tenant.
composio_strategy: Support bot credential caching (`tenant_access_token` automatic 2-hour refresh).

name: Pumble
description: Free team chat and collaboration app alternative to Slack.
api_surface: REST API (Channels, Messages, Users, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Smaller API feature set compared to Slack/Discord.
composio_strategy: Implement direct channel messaging and webhook post tools.

name: Discord
description: Community chat, voice, and streaming platform for creators and developers.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API v10, Gateway WebSockets, Slash Commands & Interactions.
main_blocker: Privileged Gateway Intents (Message Content) required for bots in >100 servers.
composio_strategy: Expose channel post, interaction reply, embed builder, and thread creation.

name: Telegram
description: Cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging platform with open bot API.
api_surface: HTTP-based Bot API (Messages, Media, Keyboards, Inline queries), Webhooks.
main_blocker: None. Instant 30-second token creation via `@BotFather`.
composio_strategy: Support instant BYO-Bot-Token connector for rapid AI agent deployment.

name: WhatsApp Business
description: WhatsApp Business Cloud API for enterprise conversational commerce.
api_surface: Graph API Cloud API REST endpoints (Messages, Templates, Media), Webhooks.
main_blocker: Template message pre-approval required for outbound unsolicited messages; Meta Business verification.
composio_strategy: Handle 24h customer service window logic and message template dispatch.

name: Aircall
description: Cloud call center and voice integration software for sales and support.
auth_types: HTTP Basic Auth (API ID + API Token)
api_surface: REST API (Calls, Numbers, Users, Teams, Contacts, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Requires phone number provisioning on paid or trial plan to test active audio bridging.
composio_strategy: Build call logging, outbound dial initiation, and insight recording tools.

name: Vonage
description: Unified communications APIs for SMS, Voice, Messages, and Verify.
api_surface: REST APIs across SMS, Voice NCCO, Messages (WhatsApp/FB/Viber), Verify v2.
main_blocker: Voice and Messages APIs use private key RSA JWT generation.
composio_strategy: Provide built-in JWT generator for Vonage application ID & private key auth.

name: Google Ads
description: Online advertising platform and campaign management infrastructure.
api_surface: Google Ads API (gRPC and REST) covering Campaigns, AdGroups, Keywords, Reporting (GAQL).
main_blocker: Mandatory Google Developer Token approval process. Test accounts operate in sandbox only.
composio_strategy: Provide pre-approved Composio Developer Token or support user-supplied developer token.

name: Meta Ads
description: Advertising platform across Facebook, Instagram, and Audience Network.
api_surface: Graph API Marketing APIs (Ad Accounts, Campaigns, Creatives, Insights, Custom Audiences).
main_blocker: App Review and Business Verification required to move beyond development mode to public users.
composio_strategy: Utilize System User Long-Lived Access Tokens for automated agent campaign queries.

name: LinkedIn Ads
description: B2B advertising platform targeting professional audiences.
api_surface: LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform REST APIs (Campaigns, Creatives, Analytics).
main_blocker: Restricted Developer Program. Access to Marketing APIs requires formal application review.
composio_strategy: Apply for verified Composio Partner application to grant end-users 1-click OAuth2.

name: GoHighLevel
description: All-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform for marketing agencies.
api_surface: REST API v2 (Contacts, Opportunities, Calendars, Workflows, Snapshots), Webhooks.
main_blocker: Requires HighLevel Marketplace Developer account or agency sub-account.
composio_strategy: Support Location-level and Company-level OAuth tokens for multi-client agency setups.

name: Mailchimp
description: Email marketing automation and audience growth platform.
api_surface: Marketing REST API v3 (Audiences, Campaigns, Automations, Reports), Webhooks.
main_blocker: None. Free account provides instant API key; datacenter prefix must be extracted.
composio_strategy: Parse server prefix automatically from API key (e.g. `key-us19` -> `us19.api.mailchimp.com`).

name: Klaviyo
description: Intelligent marketing automation for e-commerce brands.
api_surface: JSON:API formatted REST API (Profiles, Events, Lists, Segments, Campaigns, Flows).
main_blocker: None. Free account includes instant private API key generation.
composio_strategy: Standardize JSON:API envelope serialization across Klaviyo tool actions.

name: systeme.io
description: All-in-one marketing platform, sales funnels, and course delivery tool.
api_surface: REST API covering Contacts, Tags, Courses, Students, Sales.
main_blocker: Limited API breadth (focused mainly on contacts, courses, and sales).
composio_strategy: Create lightweight contact synchronization and funnel trigger toolkit.

name: Pinterest
description: Visual bookmarking, inspiration search engine, and pin promotion platform.
api_surface: Pinterest REST API v5 (Pins, Boards, Media, Catalogs, Ads, Analytics).
main_blocker: Trial apps are rate-limited to 1,000 calls/day until approved for standard access.
composio_strategy: Enable automated pin creation, board management, and analytics fetch.

name: Threads (Meta)
description: Meta text-based social conversation platform.
api_surface: Threads Graph API (Publishing text/images/video, Retrieving insights, Reply management).
main_blocker: App Review required before publishing posts for external public users.
composio_strategy: Build two-step media container publishing tool (`/threads` container + `/threads_publish`).

name: SendGrid
description: Cloud transactional and marketing email delivery infrastructure.
api_surface: REST API v3 (Mail Send, Marketing Campaigns, Stats, Suppression Lists, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Sender identity domain DNS verification required to prevent spam filtering.
composio_strategy: Provide instant email send tool (`/v3/mail/send`) with HTML template parameter support.

name: Shopify
description: Leading global commerce platform for online stores and retail POS.
auth_types: Custom App Admin API Access Token (`shpat_...`)
api_surface: Extensive Admin REST & GraphQL APIs, Storefront GraphQL API, Webhooks.
main_blocker: None. Free Partner Accounts allow unlimited developer development stores.
composio_strategy: Support GraphQL Admin API queries for batch order updates and product inventory sync.

name: WooCommerce
description: Open-source, customizable e-commerce plugin built on WordPress.
auth_types: Consumer Key + Consumer Secret (Basic Auth / HTTPS)
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API v3 (Products, Orders, Customers, Coupons, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Requires a live WordPress installation with WooCommerce plugin installed.
composio_strategy: Allow users to input their WordPress site URL + Consumer Key/Secret.

name: BigCommerce
description: Enterprise SaaS e-commerce platform for fast-growing brands.
api_surface: REST Store Management APIs v2/v3, GraphQL Storefront API, Webhooks.
main_blocker: Store hash must be passed in endpoint URL path (`/stores/{store_hash}/v3/...`).
composio_strategy: Store `store_hash` alongside API token during connection onboarding.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
description: Enterprise B2C and B2B commerce platform (formerly Demandware).
auth_types: OAuth2 via SLAS / Account Manager JWT
api_surface: SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API) and OCAPI (Open Commerce API).
main_blocker: Enterprise gated. Requires active Salesforce Commerce Cloud contract & Account Manager org.
composio_strategy: Build as Enterprise BYO-Credentials connector for existing SFCC enterprise customers.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
description: Flexible open-source and enterprise cloud digital commerce platform.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST and GraphQL Web APIs for Catalog, Checkout, Orders.
main_blocker: Open-source requires self-hosted server setup; Adobe Commerce Cloud requires enterprise tier.
composio_strategy: Support Admin Bearer Token auth with configurable base endpoint URL.

name: Squarespace
description: Website creation, hosting, and e-commerce store platform.
api_surface: Commerce REST API (Orders, Inventory, Products, Transactions, Webhooks).
main_blocker: API key generation is locked behind Commerce Basic/Advanced or Business paid plans.
composio_strategy: Expose order processing and inventory check tools with Bearer API Key auth.

name: Ecwid
description: Embeddable e-commerce shopping cart and online storefront platform.
api_surface: REST API v3 (Orders, Products, Customers, Categories, Storage, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Free store plan has limited API endpoints; Developer registration gives full sandbox.
composio_strategy: Integrate product catalog query and order fulfillment tools.

name: Gumroad
description: E-commerce platform for digital creators, writers, and software makers.
api_surface: REST API v2 (Products, Sales, Subscribers, Licenses, Custom Fields).
main_blocker: None. Free account offers instant token generation in developer settings.
composio_strategy: Provide license key verification and sales monitoring tools for creator agents.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
description: Amazon marketplace seller and vendor backend infrastructure API.
api_surface: Selling Partner API (SP-API) covering Orders, Reports, Feeds, Inventory, Pricing.
main_blocker: Requires registered Amazon Professional Seller account, AWS IAM ARN, and Data Protection Policy vetting.
composio_strategy: Implement complex dual-auth signature handler (LWA Token exchange + AWS SigV4 signer).

name: fanbasis
description: Creator engagement, custom experiences, and monetisation platform.
api_surface: No publicly documented developer REST API; web application only.
main_blocker: No documented public developer API or open partner portal exists today.
composio_strategy: Initiate partner outreach to encourage fanbasis to publish a public REST / MCP API.

name: DataForSEO
description: Comprehensive SEO, SERP, backlink, and keyword databases for developers.
api_surface: Massive REST API (SERP, Keywords Data, Backlinks, OnPage, Merchant, Business Data).
main_blocker: None. Free registration includes $1 credit for immediate API test calls.
composio_strategy: Wrap SERP live scraping and keyword volume lookup into core research tools.

name: SE Ranking
description: All-in-one SEO analysis, rank tracking, and competitor research suite.
api_surface: REST API (Rankings, Keyword Research, Site Audit, Backlinks).
main_blocker: API access requires an active Pro or Business paid subscription plan.
composio_strategy: Provide rank check and site audit actions for paid account holders.

name: Ahrefs
description: Industry-standard SEO backlink index, keyword explorer, and site audit.
api_surface: Modern REST API v3 (OpenAPI 3.0) covering Site Explorer, Backlinks, Keywords.
main_blocker: High API consumption cost; requires Enterprise plan or dedicated API unit add-on.
composio_strategy: Wrap Domain Rating (DR) and URL backlink count into efficient single-call agent tools.

name: MrScraper
description: Visual, no-code web scraper and automated crawler platform.
api_surface: REST API (Scrapers, Runs, Results extraction, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Free plan grants 30 scraping credits/mo with instant API key.
composio_strategy: Create automated trigger scraping run and extract dataset tool actions.

name: Apify
description: Cloud platform for web scraping, data extraction, and serverless Actors.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API (Actors, Tasks, Datasets, Key-Value Stores, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Free plan provides $5/mo recurring platform credit and instant token.
composio_strategy: Enable agents to run any community Actor and fetch parsed dataset output.

name: Firecrawl
description: Turn entire websites into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data.
api_surface: Modern REST API (`/v1/scrape`, `/v1/crawl`, `/v1/map`, `/v1/extract`).
main_blocker: None. Free tier (500 credits) + 100% open-source self-hostable engine.
composio_strategy: First-class integration for autonomous agent web research and docs ingestion.

name: Bright Data
description: Global proxy network, web data collector, and SERP scraping infrastructure.
api_surface: REST API (Scraping Browser, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Datasets).
main_blocker: KYC compliance / identity verification required for active residential IP pool usage.
composio_strategy: Integrate Bright Data Scraping Browser & Web Unlocker as agent tool primitives.

name: Sherlock
description: Open-source OSINT tool to hunt down social media accounts by username.
api_surface: Python CLI library; queries 400+ public social networks asynchronously.
main_blocker: No hosted cloud REST API; must be packaged as a local Subprocess MCP tool.
composio_strategy: Wrap Sherlock CLI as an agent-callable local OSINT tool (`sherlock <username>`).

name: Waterfall.io
description: B2B data enrichment and waterfall multi-provider orchestration engine.
api_surface: REST API (Contact Enrichment, Company Intelligence, Waterfall Cascades).
main_blocker: Gated B2B pilot. Access requires submitting an onboarding request to their sales team.
composio_strategy: Provide BYO-API-Key connector once enterprise customer obtains pilot credentials.

name: Clay
description: Data enrichment and AI messaging CRM combining 50+ data providers.
api_surface: REST API / Ingestion Webhooks (Tables, Columns, Enrichments, Rows).
main_blocker: Enrichment actions consume Clay credits rapidly; free trial provides starter credits.
composio_strategy: Build table row insertion and webhook trigger tool for Clay enrichment workflows.

name: GitHub
description: Global code repository hosting, issue tracking, and CI/CD platform.
api_surface: Extensive REST API v3, GraphQL API v4, Webhooks, GitHub Actions API.
main_blocker: None. 100% free developer access with fine-grained PATs.
composio_strategy: Expose full developer lifecycle: repo creation, branch/PR management, issue filing, code search.

name: Vercel
description: Frontend cloud platform for developing, previewing, and deploying web apps.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API (Deployments, Projects, Domains, DNS, Teams, Logs).
main_blocker: None. Free Hobby tier allows instant API token generation.
composio_strategy: Implement instant deployment trigger, env variable sync, and domain status tools.

name: Netlify
description: Web hosting and serverless backend cloud platform for modern web apps.
api_surface: OpenAPI-documented REST API (Sites, Deploys, Builds, Forms, DNS, Functions).
main_blocker: None. Free Starter tier provides full API access.
composio_strategy: Wrap site creation, ZIP deploy, and DNS record updates into agent tool actions.

name: Cloudflare
description: Global cloud network offering DNS, CDN, security, Workers, and KV storage.
api_surface: Massive REST API v4 across DNS, Workers, Pages, KV, R2, D1, Security Rules.
main_blocker: None. Free tier includes DNS, Pages, and 100k daily Worker requests.
composio_strategy: Build DNS record manager, Worker deployment, and cache purge tool actions.

name: Supabase
description: Open-source Firebase alternative with Postgres database, Auth, Storage, and Realtime.
api_surface: PostgREST API (Data CRUD), Auth API, Storage API, Management API.
main_blocker: None. Free tier includes 2 hosted Postgres projects with immediate API keys.
composio_strategy: Enable SQL execution, table query, and Edge Function invocation tools.

name: Neo4j
description: Native graph database platform for connected relationship queries.
api_surface: Neo4j Aura Management REST API, Cypher HTTP Transaction API, Bolt binary protocol.
main_blocker: None. Free Neo4j AuraDB instance provides instant cloud graph database.
composio_strategy: Provide Cypher query execution tool with node/relationship schema inspector.

name: Snowflake
description: Cloud data warehouse and analytical data processing platform.
api_surface: SQL REST API v2, Snowpark SDK, Management REST endpoints.
main_blocker: Trial account expires after 30 days ($400 credits); Key Pair signing required for automation.
composio_strategy: Implement SQL query dispatch tool with async polling for large query result sets.

name: MongoDB Atlas
description: Fully managed multi-cloud document database and App Services.
api_surface: Atlas Administration REST API (Clusters, Backups, Users), Data API (Document CRUD).
main_blocker: Admin REST API uses HTTP Digest Authentication (requires client challenge-response hashing).
composio_strategy: Handle HTTP Digest Auth in Composio backend; expose Atlas cluster management tools.

name: Datadog
description: Cloud-scale observability, infrastructure monitoring, and security telemetry.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API v1 & v2 (Metrics, Logs, Monitors, Incidents, Dashboards, Synthetics).
main_blocker: Dual header authentication (`DD-API-KEY` and `DD-APPLICATION-KEY`) across regional sites.
composio_strategy: Build dual-key credential manager with site selector (`datadoghq.com`, `datadoghq.eu`).

name: Sentry
description: Application performance monitoring, crash analytics, and error tracking.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API (Issues, Events, Releases, Projects, Alerts, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Free Developer plan allows full API token generation with scoped permissions.
composio_strategy: Expose issue fetching, stack trace inspection, and alert resolution tools.

name: Notion
description: Connected workspace for docs, wikis, project databases, and knowledge bases.
api_surface: Modern REST API (Pages, Databases, Blocks, Comments, Users, Search).
main_blocker: Explicit page/database sharing permission model required for bot access to see items.
composio_strategy: Provide rich block creation, database query filtering, and recursive page search tools.

name: Airtable
description: Low-code cloud relational database and collaborative spreadsheet platform.
api_surface: REST API (Records CRUD, Bases, Tables, Schema Metadata, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Rate limit of 5 requests per second per base requires client-side rate limiting.
composio_strategy: Implement intelligent record batching (up to 10 records per request) and schema reflection.

name: Linear
description: Purpose-built project management and issue tracker for high-performance software teams.
api_surface: High-performance GraphQL API & Webhooks covering Issues, Cycles, Projects, Initiatives.
main_blocker: None. Free plan includes full GraphQL API access with instant key generation.
composio_strategy: Wrap GraphQL mutations into atomic agent primitives (create issue, assign, transition status).

name: Jira
description: Enterprise agile project tracking, sprint planning, and ticketing tool.
api_surface: Massive REST API v3 (Cloud), Webhooks, Jira Service Management REST API.
main_blocker: Multi-site `cloudId` routing required for Atlassian Cloud 3LO OAuth.
composio_strategy: Automate cloudId discovery during OAuth2 handshake; support JQL query tool.

name: Asana
description: Work and project management software for coordinating team workflows.
api_surface: Complete REST API (Tasks, Projects, Portfolios, Workspaces, Webhooks, Custom Fields).
main_blocker: None. Free plan allows instant PAT creation in developer console.
composio_strategy: Wrap task assignment, section moves, subtask generation, and project progress tools.

name: Monday.com
description: Work OS platform for building custom workflow and team management apps.
api_surface: Modern GraphQL API v2 covering Boards, Items, Columns, Groups, Workspaces, Webhooks.
main_blocker: Dynamic column type mutation syntax in GraphQL requires JSON-encoded strings.
composio_strategy: Provide helper serializers to convert standard JSON key-values into Monday column value payloads.

name: ClickUp
description: All-in-one productivity suite for tasks, docs, chat, goals, and sprints.
api_surface: REST API v2 (Tasks, Lists, Folders, Spaces, Workspaces, Time Tracking, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Free Forever tier provides personal API key generation in user settings.
composio_strategy: Expose task CRUD, custom field updates, time logging, and checklist tools.

name: Coda
description: Interactive document platform that blends docs, spreadsheets, and apps.
api_surface: REST API v1 (Docs, Tables, Rows, Formulas, Controls, Automations), Packs SDK.
main_blocker: None. Free tier includes API token generation in account settings.
composio_strategy: Expose row insert/query tools and formula evaluation endpoints.

name: Smartsheet
description: Enterprise work execution platform using spreadsheet interfaces.
api_surface: REST API v2.0 (Sheets, Rows, Columns, Workspaces, Reports, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Active paid plan or 30-day trial needed for persistent API token usage.
composio_strategy: Implement sheet row update batching and automated webhook registration.

name: Harvest
description: Time tracking, expense management, and invoicing software for teams.
api_surface: REST API v2 (Time Entries, Projects, Tasks, Clients, Invoices, Expenses).
main_blocker: Requires passing both `Authorization: Bearer` and `Harvest-Account-Id` headers.
composio_strategy: Store Account ID alongside token during connection authentication.

name: Stripe
description: Financial infrastructure platform for payment processing and internet commerce.
api_surface: Massive REST API (Charges, Customers, Subscriptions, Invoices, Payouts, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. 100% free test mode with unlimited mock transactions and instant API keys.
composio_strategy: Provide payment link generation, invoice draft, and subscription lifecycle tools.

name: Plaid
description: Open banking financial network connecting apps to bank accounts.
api_surface: REST API (Auth, Transactions, Balance, Identity, Assets, Webhooks).
main_blocker: Production traffic requires financial institution compliance and security questionnaire.
composio_strategy: Provide instant Sandbox credentials testing for transaction fetching and account balance.

name: Binance
description: Global cryptocurrency and digital asset trading exchange.
auth_types: API Key (`X-MBX-APIKEY`) + HMAC SHA-256 Signature (Timestamp synced)
api_surface: REST API (Spot, Margin, Futures, Wallet, Market Data), WebSockets.
main_blocker: Private endpoints require cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 signature and millisecond timestamp sync.
composio_strategy: Implement automated cryptographic query string signer and Spot Testnet connector.

name: Paygent Connect
description: Enterprise payment gateway and merchant processing platform (NMI-powered / Japan).
api_surface: REST API, Direct Post API, Batch Settlement Files.
main_blocker: Enterprise gated. Requires banking partner approval and merchant onboarding agreement.
composio_strategy: Support as specialized enterprise gateway integration for enterprise customers.

name: iPayX
description: Enterprise bill presentment, payment gateway, and reconciliation system.
api_surface: REST & SOAP APIs for enterprise biller integration and transaction posting.
main_blocker: Enterprise sales wall; geared toward regulated healthcare, utility, and municipal billers.
composio_strategy: Treat as bespoke enterprise integration; not suitable for self-serve agent tool store.

name: QuickBooks
description: Small business cloud accounting, invoicing, payroll, and tax software.
api_surface: Accounting REST API v3 (Invoices, Customers, Items, Payments, Reports), Webhooks.
main_blocker: Company/Realm ID must be tracked per tenant; OAuth token lifecycle requires refresh token rotation.
composio_strategy: Maintain automated RealmId mapping and invoice creation tool primitives.

name: Xero
description: Cloud accounting software for small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API (Accounting, Payroll, Assets, Projects, Files), Webhooks.
main_blocker: `xero-tenant-id` header required on all API requests; multi-tenant selection on OAuth.
composio_strategy: Persist active tenant ID during connection and expose invoice/bank transaction tools.

name: Brex
description: Corporate cards, spend management, business banking, and expense software.
api_surface: OpenAPI REST APIs (Transactions, Expenses, Payments, Cards, Team, Budgets), Webhooks.
main_blocker: None for sandbox. Live production keys require an active Brex corporate card customer account.
composio_strategy: Support Brex mock sandbox for testing expense receipt matching and spend analytics.

name: Ramp
description: Finance automation platform for corporate cards, bill pay, and travel spend.
api_surface: Developer REST API (Cards, Transactions, Reimbursements, Bills, Accounting).
main_blocker: Requires Ramp customer credentials or developer partner invite to spin up sandbox.
composio_strategy: Provide transaction categorization, virtual card issue, and receipt sync tool actions.

name: PitchBook
description: Private capital market data, venture capital, private equity, and M&A intelligence.
api_surface: Direct Data REST API (Companies, Deals, Investors, Funds, Financials).
main_blocker: Strict enterprise sales paywall ($20k+/yr minimum subscription); no public self-serve sandbox.
composio_strategy: Target private equity and VC enterprises with BYO-PitchBook key support.

name: NotebookLM
description: AI research assistant and note-taking notebook powered by Gemini.
api_surface: GCP Vertex AI Gemini API / Enterprise Notebook APIs; consumer UI lacks standalone public REST API.
main_blocker: Consumer web app has no standalone public REST API; programmatic access routed through Google Cloud Vertex AI.
composio_strategy: Bridge via Vertex AI Gemini RAG toolkits or browser automation connectors.

name: Otter AI
description: AI meeting assistant, automated transcription, and collaborative notes platform.
api_surface: Enterprise REST API (Speeches, Transcripts, Summaries, Folders, Webhooks).
main_blocker: API keys are gated behind Otter Business / Enterprise subscriptions; consumer tiers lack API access.
composio_strategy: Support Enterprise API key connections for corporate meeting transcript ingestion.

name: Fathom
description: AI meeting recorder that records, transcribes, and summarizes Zoom/Meet/Teams calls.
api_surface: REST API (Meetings, Transcripts, Summaries, Action Items, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. API key can be generated directly in Fathom settings.
composio_strategy: Wrap meeting summary fetch and action item sync into agent CRM update triggers.

name: Consensus
description: AI-powered academic search engine extracting scientific research insights.
api_surface: REST API (Academic Paper Search, Claim Extraction, Consensus Meter, Syntheses).
main_blocker: Developer API is currently request-gated / partner invite required.
composio_strategy: Provide academic consensus verification tool for fact-checking agent workflows.

name: Reducto
description: High-performance AI document ingestion and parsing engine (PDF, OCR, tables).
api_surface: High-speed REST API (`/parse`, `/extract`, `/job`, `/table`), Python & Node SDKs.
main_blocker: None. Free $10 credit on signup with immediate API key generation.
composio_strategy: Implement PDF/complex doc to markdown parser tool for multimodal agent workflows.

name: Devin
description: Autonomous AI software engineer by Cognition AI.
api_surface: REST API & Native MCP Server protocol (Sessions, Prompts, Status, Artifacts).
main_blocker: Requires active paid Devin subscription account.
composio_strategy: Provide Devin session launcher and pull-request verification agent tools.

name: higgsfield
description: Generative video and creative AI video generation platform.
api_surface: REST API & Developer CLI (`higgsfield.ai/cli`) for video generation pipelines.
main_blocker: Compute credit balance required for rendering video outputs.
composio_strategy: Build video generation trigger and polling tool for multimedia creative agents.

name: Mermaid CLI
description: Command-line interface for generating diagrams and flowcharts from markdown.
api_surface: Node CLI executable (`mmdc` command); converts `.mmd` to SVG, PNG, PDF.
main_blocker: Requires NodeJS / Chromium runtime locally; ideal for Subprocess MCP packaging.
composio_strategy: Wrap Mermaid CLI as an instant local diagram generation tool for agents.

name: YouTube Transcript
description: High-speed API for extracting YouTube video subtitles, captions, and transcripts.
api_surface: REST API (`/transcript`, `/subtitles`, `/languages`, `/search`).
main_blocker: None. Free tier (50 requests/mo) allows instant token generation.
composio_strategy: Provide fast YouTube video URL to timestamped transcript tool.

name: Grain
description: AI meeting recorder, clip maker, and automated note-taking workspace.
api_surface: REST API (Recordings, Highlights, Transcripts, Summaries, Stories, Webhooks).
main_blocker: None. Direct composite API key format (`ak_...`) supported for immediate API calls.
composio_strategy: Implement meeting transcript retrieval and automated CRM highlight syncing.
